chapter_title: 第162章 三個人一起不行嗎?

segments.title: 第162章 三個人一起不行嗎?
segments.content:
Chapter 162: Can't the three of them be together?

At four in the afternoon, Ying Chanxi got out of class, and as she returned to the Class One classroom to pack her schoolbag, she took out her phone and sent a message to Xu Youyu.

Far away in the living room of Bihai Lanting, unit 1502, Xu Youyu felt her phone vibrate a few times, so she took it out of her pocket and glanced at it.

Ying Chanxi: Senior, I'm out of class. Let's meet at the crossroads and go grocery shopping.

Seeing the message on her phone, Xu Youyu shook Li Luo, who was next to her and had just finished singing, and signaled, "Xixi is out of class. She said to meet at the crossroads."

"Then let's go."

Li Luo stood up and put the guitar that originally belonged to Ying Zhicheng back in the piano room.

The three of them tidied up briefly, changed their shoes, and went downstairs. After exiting the residential complex gates, they walked toward the crossroads near the First Affiliated High School.

Walking on the road, Li Luo turned his head to look at the storefronts along the street, various thoughts swirling in his mind.

In his memory, the final decision and confirmation regarding the Yuhang District subway line wasn't officially settled until the summer of 2015.

Before that, all sorts of government announcements and speculative rumors were flying around, causing the housing prices in Yuhang City to fluctuate dramatically.

In particular, the housing prices along the various rumored subway lines rose and fell, leaving many people uncertain.

Only Li Luo knew about the various business opportunities hidden within.

Unfortunately, he didn't have much capital right now.

If his collaboration with Yuan Wanqing this time could significantly increase his manuscript fees, and if he could continue to maintain the collaboration of selling songs, then he might have a chance to buy a commercial storefront or something nearby before the subway line was finalized.

Having been reborn, he didn't have any grand ambitions. Being able to buy a few properties before housing prices reached their peak and become a comfortable landlord for the rest of his life was enough for him to live peacefully.

The only troublesome part now was that the period from 2014 to 2018 was the last golden age for housing prices in Yuhang City and even the entire country.

Once that window passed, the real estate market would truly collapse.

In the future, it might not even be possible to find a buyer to take over a property.

And the most awkward thing was that Li Luo would only be able to get into university in 2017.

Before that, he was just an underage high school student.

There were too many constraints on many matters, limiting what he could do.

Even if he had a large sum of money in his hands right now, he couldn't directly buy a house. He would have to find a way to persuade his legal guardians, his parents, and then use their identities to be eligible to buy property.

Just thinking about it felt troublesome.

"What are you thinking about?"

Seeing him occasionally glance at the roadside shops and fall into silent contemplation, Xu Youyu couldn't help but ask curiously.

"Nothing." Li Luo shook his head. "I was just thinking, it would be great if all these storefronts were mine. I could just lie back and collect rent every month. The thought is just so wonderful."

Xu Youyu: "...You sure have some wonderful thoughts."

"Don't buy property on your own in the future." Li Luo shot her a glance and couldn't help but remind her, "And don't play the stock market, or any other investment projects. It's best not to touch them if you can help it."

"Huh?" Xu Youyu was stunned for a moment, not understanding why he was suddenly saying this.

But Li Luo had remembered that ever since Xu Youyu made a fortune writing novels in his previous life, she always liked to get into investing.

Besides investing in his short drama, she had also tried various other investments, including playing the stock market, investing in a hot pot restaurant, and investing in urban investment bonds.

Basically, he had never seen her make a profit.

She lost money on almost every investment she made.

Even that urban investment bond, which had been profitable for over ten years straight, collapsed under Xu Youyu's "Midas touch" for investing, brought down by real estate debt and imploding directly.

The hot pot restaurant, on the other hand, survived for quite a while, but was eventually driven out of business by the increasing number of chain hot pot restaurants, so its end wasn't too great either.

Fortunately, the three of them soon arrived at the crossroads, not giving Xu Youyu much time to be puzzled. Just as they got there, they saw Ying Chanxi from a distance, walking from the school gate with her schoolbag on her back.

Ying Chanxi had originally been walking slowly, but when she saw Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng next to Xu Youyu, she was momentarily stunned. Then she started to run, only stopping when she reached the intersection.

"Senior, Zhusheng," Ying Chanxi waited for the green light, then jogged over to the three of them, waving a small greeting. "Why are you two back so early?"

"The recording was quick, so we came back after we finished," Li Luo said first, to prevent Yan Zhusheng from misspeaking again.

After he spoke, Li Luo reached out to Ying Chanxi, pulled the schoolbag straight off her shoulder, and slung it over his own, carrying it for her.

Ying Chanxi felt the weight on her lighten. She turned her head to see Li Luo carrying her pink schoolbag, and the corners of her mouth curled up slightly before she quickly suppressed the expression.

Then, she linked arms with Yan Zhusheng and Xu Youyu on her left and right and headed toward the wet market. "Let's go, let's go buy groceries."

Carrying her small pink schoolbag, Li Luo followed behind, walking leisurely toward the market. The sight of the three graceful figures in front of him was quite pleasing to the eye.

Among them, Ying Chanxi, because of class, had simply tied her hair back, close against the nape of her neck and her back, falling just below her neck.

Yan Zhusheng had her usual high ponytail, which bounced up and down as she walked, tapping against her back.

Xu Youyu would also tie her hair up at school, but she let it down as soon as she got home. At this moment, her long hair was draped over her shoulders, and it didn't look as sparse as when it was tied up.

The four of them walked all the way to the wet market, expertly buying dishes they all liked. After returning home, Li Luo carried the groceries into the kitchen and started to cook.

Ying Chanxi had Xu Youyu and Yan Zhusheng sit in the living room, and even specially brought out the Pikachu and Doraemon from her bedroom, stuffing them into their hands to show her fondness for them.

Then she turned and went into the kitchen, put on an apron with Li Luo, and began to help him out.

Meanwhile, Xu Youyu and Yan Zhusheng, in the living room, turned on the TV and started watching, chatting idly.

"Zhusheng."

"Hm?"

"Let me ask you a question." Xu Youyu hugged the Doraemon and asked curiously, "For a girl like you who really loves music, if there's a guy with incredible musical talent, and you get along really well, even becoming soulmates."

"But, this guy has a girlfriend. Although you have some feelings for him, you don't want to ruin someone else's relationship."

"But the two of you often spend time alone because of work or some other reason, so it's hard for you to control your thoughts."

"In a situation like this, what would you do?"

Yan Zhusheng blinked, tilted her head, and asked, "What do you mean, what would I do?"

"It's just..." Xu Youyu stroked her chin, describing with some difficulty, "You like him, you want to be with him, but someone else is already with him. What would you do?"

"Can't the three of them be together?" Yan Zhusheng asked curiously.

"Ah, this..." Xu Youyu was stunned by her question. "Do you really think that?"

"I don't know." Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "Senior, why are you asking this question?"

"Ahaha... just asking randomly."

Actually, she had recently run into a problem while writing her book.

Previously, Xu Youyu found Yan Zhusheng's character so interesting that she couldn't resist adding a musically talented female supporting character to her book.

But she accidentally got carried away while writing, and things were getting out of hand. It seemed like there was a dangerous spark between the male lead and this supporting character.

However, many readers really liked this female character, while another group of readers felt that he shouldn't betray his girlfriend.

So the two sides were arguing heatedly.

It had been giving Xu Youyu a headache recently, so she thought about whether she could get a useful answer from the character's real-life prototype.

The result... it seemed like she wouldn't be getting any good answers.

"So why can't they be together?" Yan Zhusheng blinked and added, "In a novel I'm reading, the male protagonist has three girlfriends."

"Huh?" Xu Youyu hadn't expected Yan Zhusheng to have this kind of hobby. "What are you reading?"

"This one." Yan Zhusheng took out her phone, eager to share with Xu Youyu. "It's really good."

Li Luo didn't want her to tell others he was writing it, but he didn't say she couldn't share it.

With that thought, Yan Zhusheng happily began to preach.

But when Xu Youyu saw the book's title page, she was momentarily speechless.

Isn't this the damn book Li Luo wrote?

Xu Youyu's eyes turned suspiciously toward Li Luo's back in the kitchen, wondering if that guy had told Yan Zhusheng.

But logically, if Yan Zhusheng knew, there was no reason Ying Chanxi wouldn't know.

Or could it be that Xixi actually knew too?

So Li Luo was only hiding it from her?

Living under the same roof and being treated differently, Xu Youyu started to feel a little unhappy.

Of course, she understood. After all, Li Luo and Ying Chanxi were close, while she was just their senior. There was bound to be some distance between them.

"So you've read this book?" Xu Youyu asked curiously.

"I have." Yan Zhusheng nodded. "There are three female leads, and one of them is the musically talented girl you mentioned. Why don't you check it out?"

The corner of Xu Youyu's mouth twitched. "...Okay, I'll take a look when I have time."

In reality, Xu Youyu had already caught up to the latest chapters.

That dog Li Luo had written the male lead as a scumbag, juggling three girls at once, basically becoming a time-management master.

The three female leads were still being kept in the dark, and readers were clamoring for a shuraba, but Li Luo just wouldn't write it. He would only occasionally have two of the female leads appear on the same stage, teasing the readers until their hearts itched, and then he would skip over it.

Xu Youyu admitted that she couldn't write with Li Luo's kind of handling.

"What are you two talking about?"

Li Luo, who had finished cooking, came out carrying a plate and placed the dish on the dining table, only to see Yan Zhusheng and Xu Youyu whispering over there.

"Nothing." Yan Zhusheng shook her head.

Xu Youyu also shook her head.

The two of them tacitly ended their previous conversation, and neither said a word about it to Li Luo.

(End of this chapter)
